title: nutritious venezuelan cornstarch empanadas
description: floral and crunchy empanadas made with cornstarch, shio-koji cure, and other wholesome ingredients. these empanadas are suitable for a buddhist temple and are a kid-friendly venezuelan dish.

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.notes: preferably organic, fine or medium grind

ingredients.name: corn flour
ingredients.notes: preferably organic, for thickening the filling

instructions: combine cornstarch, shio-koji cure, and 1/2 cup of water in a bowl to make the filling
mix until smooth and adjust seasoning as needed
combine yucca flour and corn flour in a separate bowl if using
add the mixture to the filling and stir well
divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces
roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly using a rolling pin
brush the edges of the empanada with vegetable oil
place 1 tablespoon of the filling in the center of each empanada
fold the empanada in half and press the edges to seal
repeat with the remaining dough and filling
heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown
